# cyd-lab Arduino platform: emulated ESP32 "Cheap Yellow Display" boards over the network.
#
# This platform has no core of its own. Its board builds with Espressif's esp32:esp32
# core (3.x), variant and esptool, by core reference (build.core=esp32:esp32), and adds:
#   * cyd-lab-discovery: lists powered-on cyd-lab devices as `cydlab` network ports
#   * cyd-lab-monitor:   Serial Monitor over the device's rfc2217:// port
# so Arduino IDE 2 / arduino-cli upload and monitor with no COM driver.
#
# GENERATED by gen_platform.py from esp32:esp32 3.3.12's platform.txt: re-run it if a
# newer esp32 core moves things around.

name=cyd-lab (emulated CYD boards)
version=0.1.0

pluggable_discovery.required.0=builtin:serial-discovery
pluggable_discovery.required.1=builtin:mdns-discovery
pluggable_discovery.required.2=cydlab:cyd-lab-discovery
pluggable_monitor.required.cydlab=cydlab:cyd-lab-monitor

# The esp32:esp32 platform folder (build.core.path is <it>/cores/esp32).
cydlab.esp32.path={build.core.path}/../..
cydlab.esp32.path.windows={build.core.path}\..\..

# esp32:esp32 properties that use {runtime.platform.path}, pointed back at esp32's folder:

tools.esptool_py.network_cmd=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/espota.py" -r
tools.esptool_py.network_cmd.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\espota.exe" -r
tools.esp_ota.cmd=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/espota.py" -r
tools.esp_ota.cmd.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\espota.exe" -r
tools.gen_esp32part.cmd=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/gen_esp32part.py"
tools.gen_esp32part.cmd.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\gen_esp32part.exe"
tools.gen_insights_pkg.cmd=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}"/tools/gen_insights_package.py
tools.gen_insights_pkg.cmd.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\gen_insights_package.exe"
recipe.hooks.prebuild.1.pattern=/usr/bin/env bash -c "[ ! -f "{cydlab.esp32.path}"/tools/partitions/{build.partitions}.csv ] || cp -f "{cydlab.esp32.path}"/tools/partitions/{build.partitions}.csv "{build.path}"/partitions.csv"
recipe.hooks.prebuild.1.pattern.windows=cmd /c if exist "{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\partitions\{build.partitions}.csv" COPY /y "{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\partitions\{build.partitions}.csv" "{build.path}\partitions.csv"
recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.3.pattern_args=--chip {build.mcu} merge-bin -o "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.merged.bin" --pad-to-size {build.flash_size} --flash-mode keep --flash-freq keep --flash-size keep {build.bootloader_addr} "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bootloader.bin" 0x8000 "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.partitions.bin" 0xe000 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/partitions/boot_app0.bin" 0x10000 "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin"
recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.5.pattern=/bin/cp -f "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/partitions/boot_app0.bin" "{build.path}/boot_app0.bin"
recipe.hooks.objcopy.postobjcopy.5.pattern.windows=cmd /c copy /y "{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\partitions\boot_app0.bin" "{build.path}\boot_app0.bin"
recipe.hooks.savehex.postsavehex.4.pattern=/usr/bin/env bash -c "{recipe.hooks.savehex.fqbn_to_dir} && cp -f '{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/partitions/boot_app0.bin' '{sketch_path}/build/'$FQBN_DIR'/boot_app0.bin' 2>/dev/null || true"
recipe.hooks.savehex.postsavehex.4.pattern.windows=powershell -Command "{recipe.hooks.savehex.fqbn_to_dir}; Copy-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue '{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\partitions\boot_app0.bin' ($dest + '\boot_app0.bin')"
debug.svd_file={cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/ide-debug/svd/{build.mcu}.svd
tools.esptool_py.upload.pattern_args=--chip {build.mcu} --port "{serial.port}" --baud {upload.speed} {upload.flags} --before default-reset --after hard-reset write-flash {upload.erase_cmd} -z --flash-mode keep --flash-freq keep --flash-size keep {build.bootloader_addr} "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bootloader.bin" 0x8000 "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.partitions.bin" 0xe000 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/partitions/boot_app0.bin" 0x10000 "{build.path}/{build.project_name}.bin" {upload.extra_flags}
tools.esptool_py.upload.flash_prefix=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/flasher.py"
tools.esptool_py.upload.flash_prefix.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\flasher.exe"
tools.esptool_py_app_only.upload.flash_prefix=python3 "{cydlab.esp32.path}/tools/flasher.py"
tools.esptool_py_app_only.upload.flash_prefix.windows="{cydlab.esp32.path}\tools\flasher.exe"
